sentences.text: The learned Public Prosecutor takes notice for the 1 st respondent.
The petitioner is the 3rd accused and the offences alleged against the accused persons are for the offences punishable under Sections 406,417,420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.

The subject matter of the crime is in respect of the entrustment of a Contract Carriage owned by the defacto complainant to the accused Nos.1 and 2, for the purpose of body building and the amount collected by the accused for the said purpose.
The petitioner was implicated only on the allegation that, an amount of Rs.1,20,500/- was transferred to her bank account as per the instructions of the 1st accused.

The specific case of petitioner is that the said amount was transferred for the purpose of paying the tax payable in respect of another vehicle, which was subsequently purchased by the defacto complainant and the said transactions are reflected in Annexures. A3 and A4 documents.
Therefore it is pointed out that there are no materials in the final report, to inculpate the petitioner.
On perusal of the records I find, a prima facie case in favour of the petitioner.

There shall be an interim order, staying further proceedings in C.C No.698/2022 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Pala, as against the petitioner alone, for a period of three months.
